entities.summary: DeAndre Martise Daniels is an American professional basketball player for the CD Español de Osorno of the Liga Nacional de Básquetbol de Chile (LNB). He played college basketball for the UConn Huskies, where he won a national championship and made the NCAA Final Four All-Tournament team in 2014.
